metadata.title: ax.guide: The Agentic-Web Cheatsheet
metadata.description: The open standards that let AI agents find, use, sign in to, shop on and pay websites, in plain words. What each one does, who is behind it, and how real it is today.

specs.title: Specs
specs.description: Every spec the Ora spec registry tracks: its versions, the version Ora last reviewed, and what the registry's daily watch last saw upstream.
specs.heading: Which version is current
specs.lede: The versions of each spec, the one Ora last read and turned into rules, and whether the spec has moved since. The registry is a public repository; this page reads it and its daily watch.
specs.neverChecked: The registry's watch has not published a status yet, so the upstream column is empty.

footer.about: The Agentic-Web Cheatsheet: an open, community-edited guide. Every page is a file in a public repository, so anyone can fix a sentence or add a standard with a pull request.
